问题：计算每个大区的季度毛利环比增长率

SQL: 
SELECT 
    region,
    quarter,
    gross_profit,
    LAG(gross_profit) OVER (PARTITION BY region ORDER BY quarter) AS prev_quarter_profit,
    (gross_profit - LAG(gross_profit) OVER (PARTITION BY region ORDER BY quarter)) 
        / NULLIF(LAG(gross_profit) OVER (PARTITION BY region ORDER BY quarter), 0) * 100 AS growth_rate
FROM quarterly_region_profit
ORDER BY region, quarter;

metadata.description: 计算每个大区的季度毛利环比增长率

问题：查询最近30天每个客户的订单总金额和订单数量

SQL查询：
SELECT 
    customer_id,
    COUNT(*) AS order_count,
    SUM(order_amount) AS total_amount
FROM orders
WHERE created_at >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '30 days'
GROUP BY customer_id
ORDER BY total_amount DESC;

metadata.sql: SELECT customer_id, COUNT(*) AS order_count, SUM(order_amount) AS total_amount FROM orders WHERE created_at >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '30 days' GROUP BY customer_id ORDER BY total_amount DESC;
metadata.description: 查询最近30天每个客户的订单总金额和订单数量

问题：找出销售额排名前10的商品及其分类信息

SQL查询：
SELECT 
    p.id AS product_id,
    p.product_name,
    c.category_name,
    SUM(oi.quantity * oi.price) AS total_sales
FROM products p
JOIN order_items oi ON p.id = oi.product_id
JOIN categories c ON p.category_id = c.id
GROUP BY p.id, p.product_name, c.category_name
ORDER BY total_sales DESC
LIMIT 10;

metadata.sql: SELECT p.id AS product_id, p.product_name, c.category_name, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.price) AS total_sales FROM products p JOIN order_items oi ON p.id = oi.product_id JOIN categories c ON p.category_id = c.id GROUP BY p.id, p.product_name, c.category_name ORDER BY total_sales DESC LIMIT 10;
metadata.description: 找出销售额排名前10的商品及其分类信息

问题：计算每个月的客户留存率（当月有订单的客户中，上个月也有订单的比例）

SQL查询：
WITH monthly_customers AS (
    SELECT 
        DATE_TRUNC('month', created_at) AS month,
        customer_id
    FROM orders
    GROUP BY DATE_TRUNC('month', created_at), customer_id
),
retention AS (
    SELECT 
        mc1.month,
        COUNT(DISTINCT mc1.customer_id) AS current_month_customers,
        COUNT(DISTINCT mc2.customer_id) AS retained_customers
    FROM monthly_customers mc1
    LEFT JOIN monthly_customers mc2 
        ON mc1.customer_id = mc2.customer_id 
        AND mc2.month = mc1.month - INTERVAL '1 month'
    GROUP BY mc1.month
)
SELECT 
    month,
    current_month_customers,
    retained_customers,
    ROUND(retained_customers::NUMERIC / NULLIF(current_month_customers, 0) * 100, 2) AS retention_rate
FROM retention
ORDER BY month DESC;

metadata.sql: WITH monthly_customers AS (SELECT DATE_TRUNC('month', created_at) AS month, customer_id FROM orders GROUP BY DATE_TRUNC('month', created_at), customer_id), retention AS (SELECT mc1.month, COUNT(DISTINCT mc1.customer_id) AS current_month_customers, COUNT(DISTINCT mc2.customer_id) AS retained_customers FROM monthly_customers mc1 LEFT JOIN monthly_customers mc2 ON mc1.customer_id = mc2.customer_id AND mc2.month = mc1.month - INTERVAL '1 month' GROUP BY mc1.month) SELECT month, current_month_customers, retained_customers, ROUND(retained_customers::NUMERIC / NULLIF(current_month_customers, 0) * 100, 2) AS retention_rate FROM retention ORDER BY month DESC;
metadata.description: 计算每个月的客户留存率

问题：查询每个商品分类的平均订单金额和订单数量

SQL查询：
SELECT 
    c.category_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT o.id) AS order_count,
    AVG(o.order_amount) AS avg_order_amount
FROM categories c
JOIN products p ON c.id = p.category_id
JOIN order_items oi ON p.id = oi.product_id
JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id = o.id
GROUP BY c.id, c.category_name
ORDER BY avg_order_amount DESC;

metadata.sql: SELECT c.category_name, COUNT(DISTINCT o.id) AS order_count, AVG(o.order_amount) AS avg_order_amount FROM categories c JOIN products p ON c.id = p.category_id JOIN order_items oi ON p.id = oi.product_id JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id = o.id GROUP BY c.id, c.category_name ORDER BY avg_order_amount DESC;
metadata.description: 查询每个商品分类的平均订单金额和订单数量
